input.sourceText: 为便于对共享储物柜开展较为有序的使用和管理工作，使用人员在离开场地前应当结合实际情况完成相应操作。如已清空储物柜，应在前台归还钥匙；如登记了过夜使用，可以把钥匙带走，但必须在次日12点前归还。即使登记了过夜使用，生鲜食品也必须当天取走。前台会把未归还钥匙记入交接单，方便第二天值班人员跟进，并提醒有物品留在柜中的使用者尽快取件。

input.sourceText: In the context of our wider effort to improve the reliability of the data available for monitoring electricity use, the outcome of last month's meter pilot provided an indication that the figures emerging from our two reporting systems are not always in alignment. The workshop meter recorded total use directly. The facilities dashboard estimated use by adding readings from devices connected to the internal network. On three mornings, the dashboard showed a lower total than the meter. We have not established whether the discrepancy was caused by devices being disconnected from the network or by a delay in importing their readings. We propose keeping the meter in place for another month, both to test whether the gap recurs and to give the facilities team time to inspect the import logs. This is a proposal for the workshop building only. The pilot did not cover the offices.
input.requirements: Write for colleagues who were not part of the pilot. Preserve the evidentiary limits and all proposed follow-up.

independentMeanings: ongoing aim improve reliability of electricity monitoring data
last month pilot
workshop meter directly recorded total usage
dashboard estimates sum from connected devices
three mornings dashboard lower than meter
uncertain cause disconnected devices or import delay
proposal keep meter another month
purposes test recurrence and allow inspection of import logs
workshop-only proposal and offices not covered
reviewOnly.readingReview: Bring the specific finding and its limits into view and explain how the two measurement methods differed.

input.sourceText: For the purposes of supporting the successful return of shared trays in a way that ensures their availability, there are a number of factors to take into consideration in determining the appropriate course of action following use. Once a tray has been washed and the desk attendant has checked it, you can put it on the open shelf. If the attendant is away, leave the washed tray on the drying rack with your name on a slip. A chipped tray goes in the marked tub even if the attendant has checked it. The attendant records chips so the next user is not blamed for damage they did not cause.
input.requirements: Explain the steps to new members of the print studio. Keep the two approval conditions and exception.

attendant records chips to avoid blaming next user
shared availability purpose
reviewOnly.readingReview: A newcomer should be able to find where to put the tray in each situation without reading a procedural preamble.
